title: Product expectation by conditioning on the first coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\Omega_0,\ldots,\Omega_n$ be finite sets, let $p_i$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega_i$ for each $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on their product. The expectation of $f$ under the independent product distribution factors by first averaging over coordinate $0$ and then averaging over the remaining coordinates: $\mathbb{E}[f]=\mathbb{E}_{(x_i)_{i=1}^n}\bigl[\mathbb{E}_{z\sim p_0}f(z,x_1,\ldots,x_n)\bigr]$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function on the product of coordinate spaces
